messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a staggered multi-region rollout for v2.17.3 (minor + hotfix) next Tue. Need alignment on cutoffs, canaries, and the small schema change. Please read and ack if you own any blockers.

morgan: Ack, I can coordinate canaries. Proposing windows that avoid peak traffic: US canary 09:00 PT (30m), EU canary 17:00 UTC (30m), APAC canary 01:00 JST next day (45m). Full traffic after +1h of successful canaries. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: heads up — the release includes a migration that adds an index to user_sessions. Quick lock (~30s) expected. Prefer to run during EU canary to balance load. I'll own the migration script and rollback.

linda: +1 to EU for migration. Who's on DB oncall at that time? ops-oncall: @ops-oncall will be on rotation that day, confirm?

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall. Plan: have pg_rewind-ready snapshot and a rollback SQL ready. If migration exceeds 60s, abort and fall back to feature flag.

alex: Cutoff for merges -> Tue 08:00 PT / 15:00 UTC / Wed 00:00 JST. After that only critical hotfixes via cherry-pick to release branch.

sara: Quick snippet for hotfixes (copy if needed):
```
# make a branch from release
git checkout -b hotfix/YYMMDD-release v2.17.x
# cherry-pick commit
git cherry-pick <sha>
# push and open PR -> release patch
```
Also remind folks to update CHANGELOG under releases/notes.

morgan: changelog ping -> https://internal/release-notes/2.17.3 (please add short bullets, owner + risk level).

deploy-bot: preflight checks queued...
deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: smoke tests ✅, canary health checks ready ✅, infra quotas OK ✅

linda: small ask — can we set canary routing policy to 10% traffic for first 15m, then 50% for next 15m, then 100% after verification? Prefer slow ramp in APAC because of stateful workloads.

morgan: Yes, will configure routing: US 10% -> 50% -> 100% ; EU 5% -> 50% -> 100% (because of migration) ; APAC 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 45m. I’ll post the actual routing JSON in the release doc.

raj: For the DB migration I'll include a dry-run in staging tonight and a quick health query to confirm no long locks: `SELECT count(*) FROM user_sessions WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '1 day';`

alex: rollback plan: revert to v2.17.2 autoswitch policy if we detect >3% error rate for 10m or any P0. Escalation: page oncall -> engineering lead -> SRE.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor latency and error budget. If we hit the threshold, I'll kick rollback and notify here. Please tag me in the release doc.

morgan: small ops note — bump the traffic-split TTL to allow fast rollback: set `max_canary_duration = 3600` in deploy config.

sara: Who's owning post-release smoke checks? I can run the integration smoke for search/indexing and session flow.

linda: I'll run metrics dashboards and log sampling (error traces + slow queries).

alex: great. Action items: 1) raj dry-run migration tonight, 2) morgan push routing config, 3) sara + linda post-release checks, 4) ops-oncall standby for rollback. I'll create the release page with timeline and link it here by EOD.

morgan: lgtm :rocket:

raj: lgtm, will post migration checklist after staging run.

alex: thanks everyone. If any blocker arises before cutoff ping this thread and DM me.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: merge cutoff in 24h.

linda: acked :white_check_mark:
